rationale: The final Total Investments row in the March 31, 2026 Schedule of Investments is the grand total. It equals the sum of the non-controlled/non-affiliated, non-controlled/affiliated, and controlled schedule subtotals and is independently repeated on the balance sheet and in the fair-value hierarchy. The companyfacts tag captured the complete grand total, not merely a subtotal. The amount is 94.79% of total assets of 1,216,719,402, leaving a plausible non-investment remainder of 63,306,075.
